headline: Stars’ Capobianco out four weeks with lower-body injury, Steel returns to lineup
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Dallas defenseman Capobianco will miss four weeks with a lower-body injury suffered Tuesday, while Steel is back in the lineup after missing the last two games with an undisclosed issue.

The loss lands on a team that is better than its record suggests. So far this season DAL has taken 54% of the expected goals at 5-on-5. Expected goals measure the quality of chances, so that share says the Stars are controlling play, not just collecting points. The 7-4-1 start (15 points in 12 games) has been carried by goaltending: goals saved above expected, which compares the goals a goalie allowed to what the shots should have produced, sits at +7.6 for DAL. Meanwhile the skaters are 4.6 goals short of what their chances should have produced, so the offense has room to bounce back. Special teams look solid too, with the penalty kill allowing 0.56 expected goals per game. Four weeks is a real dent, but a team with this underlying footing shouldn't slide because of it. We don't have a minutes projection for who steps into the role, so watch how the coach deploys the lineup in the next few games.
